remarks: Welcome Home to 91 Sandy Lane! This well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1-bath brick ranch is centrally located in Cheektowaga and is close to countless shops, restaurants, and everyday conveniences. You’ll be greeted by an inviting front porch before stepping inside to a bright and airy 1,336 sq ft layout that flows between the living room, kitchen, and dining area. The living and dining rooms feature cozy carpeting, while the spacious kitchen offers plenty of room for cooking, abundant cabinet storage, and included appliances. Down the hall, you’ll find three generously sized bedrooms with oak hardwood floors and ample closets, along with a full tiled bathroom. The full basement provides excellent potential for additional living space while currently offering endless dry storage as well as updated mechanics including a new tankless water heater (2024). Outside, enjoy the convenience of an attached 1.5-car garage with a rear overhead door leading directly to the patio and fully fenced backyard. There is plenty of room in the backyard to entertain and relax in the summer months. With no rear neighbors and easy access to the walking trail behind the property, this home offers a wonderful combination of comfort, convenience, and privacy. Don’t miss the opportunity to make this Cheektowaga ranch your own! Showings begin immediately, offers will be reviewed as they are received and the owners reserve the right to set a deadline.
